_comment: Copy to app/env.json and fill from `terraform -chdir=api/terraform output`. Pass it with `flutter run --dart-define-from-file=env.json`. Nothing here is a secret: all five values are visible in any request the app makes. Leave the file out entirely to build a guest-only app.
_comment_hosted_ui: Host only, no scheme. From the cognito_hosted_ui_domain output.
_comment_redirect: Must match a callback_urls entry on the Cognito app client AND the scheme the app registers (Android manifestPlaceholders, iOS CFBundleURLSchemes).
